thread.title: Retail Stock Leaders Hit New Highs, Including Apple, Lululemon, Ulta Beauty

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Retail Stock Leaders Hit New Highs, Including Apple, Lululemon, Ulta Beauty
text:
The tech-heavy Nasdaq led the stock market's action early Friday, looking to cap off a week of solid gains. Retail stock leader Lululemon Athletica ( LULU ) and IBD Stock of the Day Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ) were among the day's top performers, while top stocks Apple ( AAPL ) and BJ's Wholesale Club ( BJ ) notched new highs in the stock market today .
X Ulta Breaks Out While Lululemon Soars On EPS Beat IBD Stock of the Day Ulta Beauty advanced nearly 9% and is breaking out above a flat base's 261.50 buy point, according to MarketSmith chart analysis. The 5% buy range tops out at 274.58.
Late Thursday, the cosmetics company beat the Street's earnings and sales targets, but weaker-than-expected same-stores sales growth and Q3 profit guidance initially sank the stock in after-hours trade. But shares rallied in the premarket session, opening higher on the day and quickly moving above the buy point.
Leaderboard stock Lululemon soared to new highs Friday after smashing fiscal Q2 earnings and sales estimates . Meanwhile, total comparable sales grew 20%, well above views. Lululemon stock holds the highest-possible IBD Composite Rating at 99. The rating is a blend of key fundamental and technical metrics to help gauge a company's potential.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Retail Stock Hits New High But Reverses BJ's Wholesale hit a new high Friday, capping off a volatile week with solid gains. At its 31.58 peak price, the stock moved up as much as 5.4% before reversing lower in midday trade.
On Aug. 23, the hot IPO stock broke out past an IPO base's 27.56 entry. Just three trading days later, the company reported mixed Q2 results , its first earnings release since the company's June 28 debut. The results sparked a near 8% retreat, triggering the 7%-8% sell signal from the buy point.
On Wednesday, the volatile stock reclaimed the buy point, though investors should await a new buy point before entering the stock.
Blue-chip stock Apple extended its win streak to eight trading sessions Friday with a 1.7% gain to the 228.87 high price. The iPhone maker is nearing the 20%-25% profit-taking level from a flat base's 194.30 buy point. It has already reached that potential profit-taking level from a double bottom's 179.04 entry after a breakout on May 4.
Boat Maker In Buy Range Malibu Boats ( MBUU ) is in buy range from a cup-shaped base's 46.59 buy point. Shares advanced 2.6% to their 47.86 high price Friday.
In recent weeks, the stock rallied well off its late-July lows and hit a new high. The company will report its fiscal Q4 results on Sept. 6 before the market open. Analysts expect the firm's earnings to grow 37% to 59 cents per share on revenue of $122.7 million.
